svg.title: Noise versus a real saving, drawn to scale. The same unchanged conversation cost $0.102 on one run and $0.111 on another, about 9 percent apart. The full 14-message test went from $0.298967 for the original bot to $0.035259 for the optimized one, an 88 percent saving. The regression alert sits between the two, at 20 percent more per message.
